name: Lotus Crest Institute of Medical Sciences
description: One of the capital's largest private teaching hospitals, with a comprehensive cancer centre, radiosurgery suite, bone marrow transplant unit and a kidney and liver transplant programme. Tumour-board opinions can be arranged before travel.
address: Block B, Press Enclave Marg, Saket, New Delhi
